## Description

Analyzes a deliverable sample (PDF/DOCX/Markdown) to extract its table-of-contents structure AND, for each section, whether tables and/or charts are mandatory — then researches and drafts report content that matches the sample's exact structure and visual-element requirements. Use when: writing any consulting deliverable that must conform to a supplied sample or government/institutional template format.
